notes.title: Wekufu Version 0.5.22a is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43015970/be41dc87bb0db8c7c1b0df68d71a5ee40409b119.jpg[/img]
It has been a while, development has slowed down a bit but will start picking up soon! Hoping to bring you good news in the not so distant future.

In the meantime, a new update has released!
It brings a new feature called "[b]Reduced Violence[/b]". This is a completely optional feature you can use if you feel the violence of the game is too much for your tastes.

Below you'll find a set of examples of how it looks!
Thank you so much for participating in Wekufu's development! 💘

notes.title: Wekufu V0.5.136a small patch notes
notes.content:
Hello there everyone!
Just updated the game to fix a few bugs! Also the whole Enemy spawner code was rewritten as it had some issues and needed to be expanded as new things are coming!

Here's the list of stuff that changed
[list]
[*] Spawner code rewritten entirely, you can notice on certain zones like [b]Kurükura Mawidantu[/b] where world spawners (now different than battle spawners) spawn enemies constantly and organically and also won't spawn enemies while you're fighting, meaning that your game will be optimized at all times. There's also new Event Spawners but we'll get to that later on!!
[*] Fixed animation directions sometimes behaving weird when too many actions were made or when certain types of projectiles hit the player.
[*] Fixed an error where some Likan switches would not save its state, closing certain doors when replaying the game.
[*] Minor tuning to enemies and enemy attack pace.
[/list]

Thank you so much!! Stay safe and stay awesome!

notes.title: Update Patch Notes Wekufu Playtest 0.5.1a
notes.content:
Hey there! Thank you so much for playing Wekufu and being part of this project! I have been working hard on the game and here's a bit of the latest results!
[list]
[*]Added Keyboard Support. Keyboard mappings have also been changed to feel more natural.
[*]Added new on screen glyphs for multiple controllers + automatic controller recognition
[*]Added an additional Save Tomb on Kurükura Mawidantu, just before the battle where Aucac Runa is introduced for the first time.
[*]Added Multilingual Support (English and Spanish at the moment)
[*]Minor bug fixes and performance improvements 
[/list]

Thank you, take care and have a nice weekend!!

notes.title: Wekufu V0.5.00a is now Live!
notes.content:
[url=https://ko-fi.com/post/Wekufu-V0-5-00a-is-now-Live-R6R1FXOFK?justpublished=true&alias=Wekufu-V0-5-00a-is-now-Live-R6R1FXOFK][img]https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/useruploads/display/32458d99-7c5c-4767-abc4-e3607d794031_kofi_update__v0_5_00a.jpg[/img][/url]
A new Update for Wekufu's Pre-Alpha demo is now live!
This update features several new fixes and assets so please make sure to delete your save file before testing!

Thank you so much for participating in Wekufu's development! 

[list]
[*]Modified the pace of the demo's introduction
[*]Improved the difficulty curve
[*]Added new elements to Ngélol, including a new scene where you can learn how to Roll/Evade
[*]Created a new type of trap (you'll find it in Ngélol's new zone)
[*]Enemies now have weaknesses and will receive more damage when certain skills are used.
[*]Increased the range and damage of the Lefpülkitun skill.
[*]Fixed torch behaviour, torches now save their state and will appear on or off, depending on the state you left them before saving
[*]Fixed a UI drawing issue where the Control Display Interface was being drawn behind the Combat Hud, making it difficult to see what button should be pressed.
[*]Starting Health reduced from 130 to 100 points
[*]Added a new health collectible (hidden)
[*]Enemy and combat balance updates and small bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v0.4.59a
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for testing the game and being part of its development!
Here's a list of the updates made for this version
[list]
[*]Audio and texture compression update. Reduced in game memory use in 4K by over 30% without compromising quality.
[*]Minor bug fixes
[*]Xbox Controller Support (keyboard and other controllers work with no on screen support) - Extended on screen support coming soon
[*]Added a FPS toggle on the options menu, with this you can check how smooth the game is running in your PC.
[*]Update size reduced to 50%
[*]Improved visibility in the first region of "Ngelol mapu"
[/list]
